longbridge/gpui-kit ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.0 Stable2026-11-02T13:54:23Z

GPUI Kit v0.9.0

GPUI Kit 0.9.0 adds editor and Diff decorations, an application-level icon resolver, theme-configurable cursor blinking and an input edits event, along with many accessibility, menu, table and text-rendering fixes. The default backend moves to gpui-pre 0.3.11 and the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.13.

This is a minor release because public theme structs are now #[non_exhaustive], which breaks struct literals outside the crate. See Breaking changes below for migration.

Editor and text input

  • Gutter and overview ruler decorations: GutterDecorationCollection marks lines in a strip before the line numbers, and OverviewRulerDecorationCollection marks them on the vertical scrollbar track, e.g. for lines added, modified or deleted by version control. Highlight themes now read the created, modified and deleted status colors. (#3704)
  • Edit events: InputEditsEvent is emitted with each InputEvent::Change and carries the batch of InputEdits, each with the document after it, for Input, Textarea and Editor. (#3751)
  • Cursor blinking: Theme::cursor_blink with CursorBlink::steady(), CursorBlink::blinking(interval) and with_idle_timeout configures the caret for every input. The default stays at 500 ms with no idle timeout. (#3713)
  • Native touch selection: set_native_touch_selection leaves selection handles and the edit menu to the platform; set_selected_text_range is now implemented so the platform or IME can move the selection. (#3723)
  • Restore backward selections through set_selected_range, reuse measured wraps during live resize, keep hover working across the whole visible editor after scrolling, and paint editor popups above dialogs. (#3756, #3691, #3734, #3700)

Diff

  • Line decorations and gutter markers: Diff::decorations paints backgrounds on line ranges with DiffDecoration, and Diff::gutter_markers with render_gutter_marker places interactive markers beside lines without changing the selection. (#3703)
  • Keep the vertical scrollbar at the viewport edge when soft_wrap is off. (#3739)

Markdown and text rendering

  • Render reference-style Markdown images, continue alphabetic ordered-list numbering after Z, and preserve list body width in fitted containers. (#3683, #3722, #3759)
  • Draw marked text in a color that reads on its background. (#3746)
  • Fix an application shutdown deadlock during layout cleanup, and avoid resolving the window selection during paint in selectable text. (#3697, #3699)

Components

  • Icon: set_icon_resolver lets the application choose the path every icon is drawn from, including icons drawn inside components, for runtime icon themes. resolve_icon_path serves custom components that draw with svg(). (#3633)
  • Menu: submenu rows are activatable, and a submenu opens on the left only when the right side has no room. (#3714, #3736)
  • Table: column resize follows the point where the drag started. (#3732)
  • Combobox: correct filtered selection events and confirmation. (#3449)
  • VirtualList: rebuild cached geometry when the axis or gap changes, and use the height constraint when a horizontal list infers its height. (#3719, #3720)
  • MessageScroller: the scrollbar reaches the end of padded content. Popover clears focus on close when nothing had focus at open. Toolbar ends its wrap search at the first repeated stop. (#3615, #3718, #3716)
  • Settings: show an empty state for unmatched searches; the sidebar follows scrolling. (#3701)
  • Motion: directly built easing curves with nothing to sample behave as linear. (#3721)
  • Speech: SpeechWaveform gains a liquid appearance, SpeechButton shows the voice while capturing, and macOS privacy access no longer falls on the terminal. (#3725, #3726, #3730)

Accessibility

  • Tables give the focused element the grid role and move assistive-technology focus with the selected row or cell. (#3727, #3758)
  • Menus report checked and unchecked items correctly; command palette rows are named after their item; icon-only close buttons have names. (#3729, #3761, #3728, #3741)

Localization and testing

  • Add Russian (ru) translations. (#3745)
  • Test support can observe painted text and alternative text, and Toolbar is registered for snapshot queries. (#3724, #3717)

Breaking changes

Theme structs are #[non_exhaustive] (#3713, #3704). Struct literals, including ..Default::default(), no longer compile outside the defining crate. Later field additions will not break callers again.

  • gpui-base: Theme, SemanticThemeTokens, ColorTokens, RadiusTokens, SpacingTokens, TypographyTokens, TextStyleToken, ShadowTokens, ResizableTheme, ListSettings
  • gpui-component: Theme, ThemeColor, ThemeToken, ThemeSet, ThemeConfig, ThemeConfigColors, Semantic*Config, MotionTokens, HighlightTheme, HighlightThemeStyle, SyntaxColors, SheetSettings, NotificationSettings

Start from Default::default() or the existing constructor (ColorTokens::light, ShadowTokens::elevations, …) and assign fields:

-let theme = Theme { radius: px(4.), ..Default::default() };
+let mut theme = Theme::default();
+theme.radius = px(4.);

DisplayMap is no longer UnwindSafe / RefUnwindSafe.

Upstream GPUI compatibility

gpui-pre 0.3.11 / gpui-fast 0.1.13 (#3766):

  • Window::text_system() returns &Rc<WindowTextSystem> instead of &Arc, and WindowTextSystem is no longer Send/Sync.
  • Animation reads the executor clock instead of Instant::now(), so it follows the test clock. Tests that slept on the wall clock should use advance_clock.

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!

code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v5.1.58 Stable2026-11-02T13:40:11Z

Runs on senpi 2026.11.2-1: Claude subscription sign-in works again. (#12126)

A timed-out or cancelled ultimate-browsing template gives its browser a graceful quit. On macOS/Linux the executor runs each Playwright template in its own session and, on timeout or cancellation (Ctrl-C), sends SIGTERM to the template's process group and waits up to 5 s before SIGKILL, so Chrome can quit cleanly and remove its macOS code-sign clone and temp profile instead of being orphaned. The bundled omowright browser engine is pinned at the release whose pipe-launched browsers also get a graceful quit (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period) when the engine closes them. (#12068)

Fixed

  • The builtin dev-browser skill's macOS/Linux standalone command now runs a release step before server.sh. When nothing answers on 9222, it sends SIGTERM to whatever holds 9223, waits up to 5 s, and sends SIGKILL only to survivors. dev-browser's start-server.ts then finds the port free and never reaches its kill -9, so a browser gets its clean exit and does not leak per-launch state such as the macOS Chrome code-sign clone. A running server on 9222 is left alone, and the step does nothing when curl or lsof is missing. It works the same under bash and zsh. The upstream fix is SawyerHood/dev-browser#146. (#12071, part of #12067)
  • A delegated task now runs only on the models designated for it (its category's or agent's model chain). It never falls back to the parent session's model, whatever the failure: a usage limit, a missing or rejected sign-in, a content-policy refusal or an overload on every designated model ends the task with failure_kind: "model_chain_exhausted" and an error listing each model it tried and why, including any reset time the provider reported. This applies to every category and to workflow nodes. A categories.<name>.provider_lock key left in omo.json is ignored. (#12006, #11781) (#12010)
  • Keep an unacknowledged task-host session close reachable by teardown so detaching releases its transport instead of leaving the connection open until the RPC deadline. (#11931)

Changed

  • The macOS (darwin-arm64) EQ.omo goldens for E21-E24 are re-recorded against senpi 2026.10.31-2, and recording now refuses a golden that carries a host-only notice or terminal event, so a machine-specific row can no longer be committed as the expected output. (#12056, fixes #12054)

Added

  • The device service SDK (@oh-my-opencode/device-service-core) can download, verify and install the OmO device service and run its start-up bootstrap: the release signature is checked with the repository's strict Ed25519 helper against a compiled-in release key, every file against the signed checksums, and the release lands in the service's state dir only after every check passed. Nothing calls it yet, and the release key is a placeholder until it is published. (#12052)

cjpais/Handy ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.10.0 Stable2026-11-02T13:13:42Z

This is a substantial release, and it marks Handy being roughly feature complete as we move towards V1.

In this release, there are some big features like transcribing audio files, auto language detection for all of the transcription models we support, a brand new onboarding flow, and starting to redesign some of the UI. There are a ton more quality of life improvements and small little details that hopefully you'll enjoy as well.

The coming releases will be addressing issues and stability. From here on out, you shouldn't expect too many new features from Handy, but you should expect the app to become more beautiful and stable.

Given there's a lot of new features, likely there will be some new issues, and we will address those in the rest of this release, and it will wrap us up and bring us to V1. A massive, massive thank you to all the contributors, for this release. A ton of PRs have came in, and really appreciate people submitting fixes and continuing to help the app improve.

v0.9.3 Stable2026-11-02T12:31:19Z

HyperFrames v0.9.3

Released on 2026-11-02.

Stamping a project's ids no longer holds up the Studio host, and long media clips no longer leave it unanswered. A preview reload writes the composition as it is now. Measure and diff say why they failed.

Features

  • Studio Server: Stamp a project hf-ids without holding the event loop (d17b958318, #7004).

Fixes

  • Studio Server: Long media clips no longer leave the host unanswered (c54f84859d, #7002).
  • CLI: Measure and diff report why they failed, and reverse reports its runs (618c486734, #6997).
  • Studio: A preview reload writes the composition as it is now, not as it was when it asked (a46412ee07, #6998).
  • Core: Keep media prefetch queue ordered (aaa5b63f55, #6996).
  • Lint: A helper script's timeline nested by the page is not reported as unregistered (43f8b1a3fc, #6999).

A scene that has ended now gives up its WebGL context, so the next scene is not slowed. A heavy clip's lighter copy can be made ahead of time. Apps that host Studio can ask which action holds a key combination.

  • Studio: Hosts can ask which action holds a key combination (5fca435623, #6979).
  • Core: A heavy clip's lighter copy can be made ahead of time (e5b10f8bc2, #6982).

Fixes

  • Engine: A scene that has ended gives up its WebGL context so the next scene is not slowed (26d6e3eef1, #6984).

v0.9.0 Stable2026-11-02T05:41:28Z

HyperFrames v0.9.0

Released on 2026-11-02.

Distributed rendering on AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run now runs only on Plan v2. This is a breaking release: the Plan v1 transport, the planProtocol option and the Plan v1 event and result types are removed. A preview video that runs short of data now holds instead of looping snippets.

Upgrading from 0.8

  • Upgrade the SDK and the deployment together. Redeploy your Lambda stack or Cloud Run service from 0.9.0 when you move your app to the 0.9.0 SDK.
  • Drop planProtocol from renderToLambda and renderToCloudRun calls. Leaving it out, or passing "v2", works as before. Passing "v1" now throws.
  • Old Plan v1 events are rejected. A handler or service on 0.9.0 answers a v1 payload with PLAN_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED before doing any render work.
  • Removed producer exports: plan, createPlanV2FromV1, publishPlanV2FromV1, readPlanProtocol, readPlanProtocolV1, PLAN_PROTOCOL_V1, CURRENT_PLAN_PROTOCOL, PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION, PLAN_HASH_SCHEMA, PLAN_ARTIFACT_LAYOUT, DISTRIBUTED_RENDER_CAPABILITIES and getDistributedRenderCapabilities, plus their types. Use planV2, planV2WithPublisher or publishPlanV2FromExecutionPlan instead.
  • PLAN_TOO_LARGE and PlanTooLargeError are removed from @hyperframes/producer/distributed. The plan-size cap only applied to Plan v1, and Plan v2 never raises it, so drop any checks for that error.
  • Removed adapter types: LambdaPlanProtocol, PlanV1LambdaResult, CloudRunPlanProtocol, PlanV1ResultBody, and PlanV1Event, RenderChunkV1Event and AssembleV1Event from both adapter packages.

Breaking Changes

  • Producer, AWS Lambda, Cloud Run: Remove the Plan v1 distributed transport (7f48a6894, #6970).

Fixes

  • Core: A preview video short of data holds the film instead of looping snippets (8519f2836, #6974).
  • CLI: Diff warns when yours runs at another frame rate (99223d993, #6976).
  • Core: A smaller preview copy nobody wants any more no longer swaps in (6bbda219b, #6973).
  • CLI: Diff stops counting a fast move as an extra cut (b1316e61d, #6978).

Full changelog

HyperFrames v0.8.228

Released on 2026-11-01.

One loud moment no longer turns down a whole export. Only its peaks come down, so quiet passages keep their level. Preview music keeps playing while a video swaps to a new copy, and a render now warns when it does have to lower the whole mix.

Fixes

  • Producer: An export over the ceiling limits its peaks and keeps the mix's level (d1d631f60, #6940). A mix far over the ceiling now gets several dB of limiting on those peaks, which can be audible on dense material, and the export can differ from its preview there.
  • Core: Music keeps playing while a preview video swaps to a new copy (89a595316, #6937).
  • CLI: A render says when it lowered the whole mix, and how to keep the level (f9e8cab67, #6938).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Reverse-any-video gets a recipe for animated and painted films (aa77770eb, #6933).

v1.5.0 Stable2026-11-02T11:05:31Z

New Features

  • Extension update changelogs: see what changed in installed extension packages on the next fresh launch after an update. Package authors can choose the changelog path, and collapseChangelog condenses the notices. See Show a changelog.
  • Faster streaming: large tool calls are parsed incrementally, and code-heavy answers and tool rows reuse highlighting and rendered Markdown instead of repeating the work on every update. See Keep rendering responsive.
  • Custom self-update commands: use PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND or selfUpdateCommand to update pi through a wrapper or another package manager. See Custom update command.
  • GPT-6.1 Terra: available through OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Codex, with tool search, mid-conversation thinking-level changes, and thinking off. Codex offers a 500K context window. See Models.

Breaking Changes

  • Tool argument validation runs on @earendil-works/pi-schema. TypeBox features outside JSON Schema (Type.Refine(), Type.BigInt(), Type.Undefined(), codecs, Format.Set() formats) no longer apply to tool arguments; see Tool parameter schemas and TypeBox. Plain JSON Schema tools, including MCP tools, now get the same coercion as TypeBox tools, such as converting numeric strings and wrapping a single value into an array. Validation failures the model sees list pi-schema's messages (- path: missing, - limit: expected number, got string) instead of TypeBox's (must have required properties path, must be number).

Added

  • Extension packages can now show their changelog after an update. Pi reads pi.changelogPath from the package's package.json, or CHANGELOG.md in the package root, and on the next fresh launch shows entries newer than the last seen version under "Extension Updates". The collapseChangelog setting condenses this to one line per package (#5958, #8790)
  • pi.exec() accepts a maxBuffer option that limits stdout and stderr combined, and its result has a truncated field that is true when output exceeded the limit (#11360)
  • Device-code login (for example GitHub Copilot) now opens the verification page and copies the code when you press Enter. Providers can turn either action off with openBrowserOnConfirm: false or copyCodeOnConfirm: false (#9282, #9301)
  • pi update can update Pi through a wrapper or another package manager. Set PI_SELF_UPDATE_COMMAND (for example mise use -g npm:{packageName}@{version}) or the global selfUpdateCommand setting; pi update runs it when pi.dev reports a newer release and fills {packageName}, {version}, and {installSpec} from that release. See Custom update command (#7756, #5607)
  • Extensions can format the user's configured keybindings with keyText() and keyHint() from the tool render context and the message and entry renderer options. Importing these functions from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent can resolve the extension's own copy of the package, which does not see pi's keybindings, so hints such as keyHint("app.tools.expand", "to expand") rendered without the key. The docs now recommend the injected functions (#4748)
  • Added persisted session-entry messageId and ISO timestamp to MarkdownTransformContext. They are available when rendering saved entries and undefined for live rendering (#7952 by @vipentti)
  • Added a blocked option to inline ctx.ui.custom() components so approval prompts and other custom dialogs can report that pi is waiting for user input. Overlays ignore the option. See Custom screens and overlays (#11428)
  • Added Usage.cost.totalFromProvider to distinguish billed totals from catalog estimates in SDK and extension usage data; combined usage is marked provider-reported only when every part is (#11178)
  • Added concrete responseModel metadata to messages from pi-messages providers such as Radius, including when a virtual model is requested. See AssistantMessage (#11265)
  • Added GPT-6.1 Terra for OpenAI, Azure OpenAI Responses, and OpenAI Codex, with tool search and mid-conversation thinking-level changes. It supports thinking off; Codex offers a 500K context window

Changed

  • Extensions keep importing Type, Static and TSchema from @earendil-works/pi-ai: Pi maps that import to pi-ai's compat entry plus the TypeBox it bundles, now that pi-ai itself no longer re-exports TypeBox, and its StringEnum there stays a TypeBox TUnsafe<T>. The built-in tool factories (createReadTool() and the others) return TypeBoxAgentTool<typeof schema>, which keeps params typed for TypeBox.
  • Tightened system prompt
  • pi update for installs from the pi.dev installer no longer passes --min-release-age=0 to npm ci. The release lockfile pins every package, so the flag had no effect, and security scanners that block it stopped the update (#11262)
  • /model and /scoped-models now show a model's name next to its ID when the name adds words the ID lacks, such as a renamed models.json override (#5916, #11347)
  • MCP OAuth sign-in now uses pi's Client ID Metadata Document by default when the authorization server supports it for public clients, and registers a client dynamically otherwise, like Codex, Claude Code, and opencode. Clients registered before stay in use while their redirect URI matches. The new default oauth.clientRegistration: "auto" registers when clientName or a non-default callbackUrl is set; "dcr" always registers. pi mcp add --oauth-client-registration sets the mode (#11426)
  • Changed the default OpenAI model from gpt-5.5 to gpt-6.1-sol, including after ChatGPT sign-in when no model is selected (#11442)
  • Updated the built-in model catalog to models.dev v2. Realtime and image-only models are no longer offered as chat models; newer OpenAI and Google chat models are included

Fixed

  • Updated glob matching to prevent denial of service from amplified glob patterns.
  • Fixed a saved "Do not trust" decision being ignored for projects without trust-requiring resources, for example a folder with only AGENTS.md. pi auto-trusted such projects, so ctx.isProjectTrusted() returned true and package commands treated them as trusted. A saved decision in trust.json now takes precedence; auto-trust applies only when no decision is saved (#10947)
  • Fixed Shift+Enter queueing a follow-up instead of inserting a newline in Apple Terminal setups that send ESC + Return. pi now checks the local Shift key state for that sequence, as it already did for plain Return; Alt+Enter without Shift still queues a follow-up (#11559)
  • Fixed the working status (OSC 7501) disappearing in Rex and iTerm2 during runs in regular TUI mode. Rendered messages wrote OSC 133 prompt markers to the terminal, which the terminal treats as a new shell prompt; regular mode no longer writes them (#11519)
  • Fixed compaction, branch summaries, and bug-report summaries in SDK sessions passing the stored OAuth token back to the model runtime as an explicit API key. Provider auth that treats explicit keys differently from stored OAuth now sees the OAuth login, as normal prompts do (#11520)
  • Fixed a redundant system prompt update (tools, rules) when an extension set the same active tools in a different order, for example a reversed pi.setActiveTools() list. Tools that stay active now keep their order and newly activated tools are appended (#11495)
  • Fixed pi.exec() crashing pi with RangeError: Invalid string length when a command printed more output than fits in a string. The default output cap is the smaller of 256 MiB and the runtime string limit; past the cap, the command is terminated and the result has truncated: true and a nonzero exit code (#11360)
  • Fixed pi.exec() never returning when a command ignored SIGTERM after a timeout or abort. pi now sends SIGKILL 5 seconds later, as intended
  • Fixed pi install and pi remove adding ever deeper nested entries to the npm package-lock.json when the agent directory is reached through a symlink, such as ~/.pi linked into a dotfiles repo. pi now passes the resolved real path to npm (#11358)
  • MCP sign-in now rejects authorization endpoints and other OAuth metadata URLs that are not http: or https:. Before, a malicious MCP server could supply a file: or custom protocol URL, which pi passed to the platform URL handler.
  • Automatic fd and rg downloads no longer fetch x86-64 binaries on ARM32 and other architectures without a prebuilt release. pi now warns and recommends installing the tool with the system package manager (#11209)
  • Fixed /model search ranking letters scattered over an earlier part of an entry above a real match, for example opus listing gpt-oss-120b and claude-sonnet-4.5 before claude-opus-4.1 (#11220, #11296)
  • Fixed /resume search matching scattered letters anywhere in session messages and IDs, for example 1024 matching inside a session UUID. Session names and working directories still match fuzzily; IDs and message text now match only as exact substrings (#11220, #11024, #11296)
  • Fixed HTML export showing a blank page for sessions with thousands of entries (#11225, #11293)
  • Fixed HTML export not showing system messages: the system prompt and tools, and later section updates such as after /reload. pi --export now includes the system prompt and tools too (#11261, #3464, #11290)
  • Fixed aborting a bash command on macOS sometimes running the next command of a list such as long_step; next_step. pi now stops the process group before killing it (#11252, #11289)
  • Fixed large streamed tool calls taking excessive CPU time and memory because every delta re-parsed the accumulated arguments. Providers and agent proxy streams now parse each delta once, grammar tools no longer copy their entire input per delta, and interactive tool renderers run at most once per frame (#9265)
  • Fixed the login dialog opening sign-in URLs that are not web URLs, and printing control characters from sign-in, device-code, and info URLs, which could end a terminal hyperlink and send escape sequences to the terminal
  • Fixed tui.select.pageUp and tui.select.pageDown being ignored in slash command and file autocomplete, /settings, and the model, scoped models, login, fork, /mcp, and llama.cpp selectors. In fullscreen mode, PageUp/PageDown now move an open list or autocomplete menu instead of scrolling the transcript, and a page key bound to Ctrl+V pages autocomplete instead of pasting an image (#7629, based on #7680 by @muyiyr)
  • Fixed tool output and ! command output showing the parameters of control sequences with a <, = or > prefix as text, for example 35;59;1M from a mouse report ESC[<35;59;1M or 0;276;0c from a terminal reply ESC[>0;276;0c. Text after the keypad-mode sequences ESC= and ESC> is still kept (#11377)
  • Fixed pi -e npm:<pkg> staying on the version from the first download. On each start and /reload, pi now reinstalls an -e npm package without an exact version when the registry has a newer matching version. pi -e git:<repo>@<branch> likewise stayed on its first checkout and is now fetched and reset to the branch; a commit-hash ref that is already checked out is not fetched. Offline mode and failed checks keep the cached copy (#11375, #11590)
  • Fixed Windows paths being compared case-sensitively. When the working directory and home directory differed only in drive-letter casing (c:\Users\me vs C:\Users\me), skills in ~/.agents/skills loaded twice, as project and user skills, and were reported as name collisions. The same mismatch also re-asked for saved project trust, hid sessions in a custom session directory from --continue and /resume, and stopped pi remove from matching configured local packages (#10488)
  • Fixed paths next to the home directory being shown with a broken ~ prefix, for example /home/me2/project shown as ~2/project when home is /home/me
  • Fixed pi mcp login -l and pi mcp logout -l failing with Unknown option --local. although pi mcp add and pi mcp remove accept -l. With -l, they now require the server to be a project server. Unknown options are now reported as typed, and a mistyped server name gets a suggestion, for example Did you mean "gurker"?
  • Fixed pi update naming pnpm for installs that only live under PNPM_HOME, for example a wrapper under $PNPM_HOME/global-nub/. pi said "not managed by a global pnpm install"; it now names the package manager only when that manager owns the install (#7756)
  • Fixed image paste, copy, and opening the browser for sign-in failing silently on WSL when the working directory is deep. Windows programs such as powershell.exe and explorer.exe cannot start from a directory whose \\wsl.localhost\... path exceeds 260 characters; pi now starts these helpers from / (#11592)
  • Fixed the external editor failing silently, for example when the editor command is wrong or a Windows editor cannot start from a deep WSL directory. pi now shows a status message such as External editor exited with code 1; prompt unchanged (#11592)
  • Fixed tool_search and codemode searchTools() ranking a tool below tools that only mention its name in their descriptions, for example peekaboo app ranking mcp__peekaboo__app 14th. A tool matching more of the query's words now ranks above one matching fewer, a query word in a tool's name scores more than any number of mentions in its description, a tool whose whole name is in the query gets a large bonus, and long server instructions no longer lower the scores of that server's tools (#11331)
  • Fixed tool_search and codemode searchTools() finding nothing for Chinese, Japanese, Thai, and other non-ASCII queries, because the tokenizer kept only ASCII letters and digits. Words in any script now match, text without spaces between words such as 搜索记录 is split into words, and canonically equivalent text such as café and cafe\u0301 matches (#10816, #11037 by @haoqixu)
  • Fixed pi update stopping with git clean -fdx failed with code 1 on Windows when another pi session had a git extension's native module or executable open. Windows cannot delete such files, so the update left the new code with the old dependencies. pi now warns, installs the dependencies anyway, and retries the clean on the next update (#11597)
  • Fixed tool rows and streamed answers highlighting the same code again on every redraw. A running codemode row highlighted its whole script on every progress update and timer tick, a complete write row its whole file on every update and expand toggle, a streamed write its first 50 lines on every delta, and a streamed answer every earlier code block on every delta. Rows now reuse their last highlighting until the code, theme, or loaded grammars change, and assistant messages keep their rendered Markdown blocks while streaming (#10971)
  • Fixed resized photos being sent as multi-megabyte PNGs even when JPEG was much smaller, causing large requests to fail or time out. Image resizing now tries the smaller encoding first (#11551)
  • Fixed pi update --extensions reporting success without warning when npm's stale registry metadata left a package at its old version. pi now reports the installed and expected versions (#11536)
  • Fixed skill validation warnings being labeled [Skill conflicts] even when there was no name collision. They are now shown under [Skill warnings] (#11521)
  • Fixed codemode tool descriptions including entire union and multi-line output types in every request. Object unions now summarize their fields and discriminators; other multi-line types point to describeTool() for the full declaration (#11501)
  • Fixed the model-scope startup notice being left in the shell after exiting fullscreen mode. It now appears inside pi's fullscreen header (#11508)
  • Fixed startup from a deleted working directory crashing with an uncaught uv_cwd stack trace. pi now asks the user to change to an existing directory (#11509)
  • Fixed failed session writes leaving entries in memory that were absent from disk, so later entries pointed to missing parents and resumed sessions lost earlier history and tools (#11460)
  • Fixed /tree branch summaries ignoring the session's thinking level, which could make reasoning models reject summary requests with an unsupported none effort (#11444)
  • Fixed hidden thinking with an empty hidden-thinking label still adding blank rows before answers and tool calls (#11402)
  • Fixed package installation and removal printing npm audit and funding advice, including npm audit fix instructions that could install a second copy of pi into the package directory (#11409)
  • Fixed replacing an extension editor while a dialog was open hiding the dialog and leaving it unanswerable. The new editor now appears after the dialog closes (#11431)
  • Fixed grep context lines being offset from ripgrep's match line numbers when a file contains a lone carriage return (#11398)
  • Fixed --model <provider>/<id> failing for provider IDs containing slashes, such as URL-derived llama.cpp provider IDs (#11394)
  • Fixed slow session forking on filesystems where opening files is expensive by writing the fork through one file handle (#11253)
  • Fixed pi.exec() corrupting UTF-8 characters split across stdout or stderr chunks (#11312)
  • Fixed pi.exec() returning empty stderr when a command could not be spawned, such as a missing executable. It now preserves the spawn error message (#11257 by @muyiyr)
  • Fixed a configured package failing to install crashing startup. pi now skips the package, reports an extension warning, and retries on the next start or /reload; explicit install and update commands still fail with a nonzero exit (#11304 by @Lincoln504)
  • Fixed the todo extension example crashing the TUI when a tool call failed argument validation (#8057 by @cyzlmh)
  • Updated undici to 8.12.3 and the Gondolin extension example to 0.14.0 for security advisories
  • Fixed OpenRouter cost totals using catalog estimates instead of reported billing for Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages. BYOK totals include both OpenRouter charges and reported upstream costs; component costs remain catalog estimates (#9980)
  • Fixed OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go requests using shared endpoints instead of their protocol-specific OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and System One endpoints (#11434 by @vimtor)
  • Fixed Zhipu/Z.ai usage-limit errors (code 1308) being treated as transient HTTP 429 errors, causing automatic retries that cannot succeed until the usage cap resets (#11537)
  • Fixed LiteLLM's ContextWindowExceededError not being recognized as context overflow (#11492)
  • Fixed Gemini tool schemas sending unsupported const keywords. They are now converted to single-value enum schemas without rewriting literal data in defaults, examples, or enum values, or losing properties named __proto__ (#11308)
  • Fixed the faux provider counting simulated cache-write tokens as both input and cache writes
  • Fixed Orca terminals falling back to text for inline images. Orca is now recognized as supporting true color and hyperlinks, and Kitty images when it advertises ORCA_IMAGE_PROTOCOL=kitty (#9329 by @XRX193)
  • Fixed bare Markdown URLs swallowing following CJK punctuation and text; explicit Markdown links and angle autolinks are unchanged (#10934 by @haoqixu)
  • Fixed Kitty-protocol F1–F12 shortcuts, including modified function keys, not being recognized, and F13+ and other functional keys inserting invisible private-use characters into the editor (#11419, #11345)
  • Fixed Kitty images inside padded or colored boxes disappearing when their first row scrolled above the fullscreen viewport. Partially visible images are now cropped correctly, including beside other text
  • Fixed deeply nested Markdown blockquotes producing exponentially many lines, hanging or crashing rendering once their borders exhausted the available width (#11272)
  • Fixed Claude sessions failing with role 'system' must precede an 'assistant' message when a system update was followed by an empty or reasoning-only assistant reply (#11091)
  • Fixed Claude mid-conversation thinking-level changes failing with Invalid effort level on accounts whose organization caps effort below high (#10063)
  • Fixed Kimi K3.1 Pro models using Kimi K2 request settings on Kimi Coding, Moonshot, and OpenCode Go. They now send the correct reasoning effort, preserve earlier thinking, accept tools added mid-conversation, and use K3-family pricing
  • Fixed OpenCode DeepSeek V4.1 Flash requests failing when long cache retention sent the unsupported prompt_cache_retention parameter
  • Fixed GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 failing with Missing namespace for function_call after switching from a model that had called tools (#11415)
  • Fixed Bedrock Claude requests failing when preferred strict tools exceed the provider's strict-tool limits. Requests now retry once with preferred tools non-strict while keeping required strict tools strict (#11416)
  • Fixed OpenRouter's ~anthropic/claude-*-latest aliases losing earlier thinking after tool calls by using the Anthropic Messages API (#9534)
  • Fixed terminal titles containing control characters being able to inject terminal escape sequences, and pi-messages streams accepting invalid content-block indices
  • Fixed fullscreen double-click selection splitting paths and tokens at ~, ., \, and +; word characters now match iTerm2's defaults (#10980)
  • Fixed display math wider than the content area being split apart by line wrapping; it now falls back to raw LaTeX (#11483)
  • Fixed styled words ending exactly at the wrap width adding a leading space on the next line, and strikethrough leaking into wrapped-line padding (#10925)
  • Fixed /tree branch summaries including failed assistant replies and original content that context edits had hidden or replaced. Summaries now honor the same context edits as live requests and compaction (#11602)

Removed

  • Removed the native OS sandbox/ extension example and its dependency. Use the Gondolin example or the containerization guide.

English → · 网页版完整更新日志 →

概览

Reasonix v1.39.11 — Reasonix 1.39.11

安全修复：python3 -v 脚本 不再被当成只读的版本探针，和其他会运行代码的命令一样需要先批准。

发布日期：2026-11-02

Desktop 1 · CLI 1

桌面端更新

重点内容

  • [Desktop · CLI] python -v 不再被当作只读的版本探针 — Python 里 -v 是显示模块导入过程，不是版本参数，所以 python3 -v 脚本 会运行这个脚本。Reasonix 过去把它当作只读命令，在「询问」模式和只读模式下都不经询问就直接运行。现在 python、python3 只有 --version 和 -V 这两种精确写法算只读，其余都需要批准。从不可信文件夹打开的仓库，不能再借此不经提示地运行它自带的脚本。详见 GHSA-qrrg-f72x-hx7r。 (#14928 by @esengine)

CLI 端更新

重点内容

  • [Desktop · CLI] python -v 不再被当作只读的版本探针 — Python 里 -v 是显示模块导入过程，不是版本参数，所以 python3 -v 脚本 会运行这个脚本。Reasonix 过去把它当作只读命令，在「询问」模式和只读模式下都不经询问就直接运行。现在 python、python3 只有 --version 和 -V 这两种精确写法算只读，其余都需要批准。从不可信文件夹打开的仓库，不能再借此不经提示地运行它自带的脚本。详见 GHSA-qrrg-f72x-hx7r。 (#14928 by @esengine)

升级提醒

本版本无需手动迁移。

风险提示

当前没有需要额外操作的已知风险。

  • 官网按平台下载
  • 查看完整差异

桌面端更新

重点内容

  • [Desktop · CLI] python -v 不再被当作只读的版本探针 — Python 里 -v 是显示模块导入过程，不是版本参数，所以 python3 -v 脚本 会运行这个脚本。Reasonix 过去把它当作只读命令，在「询问」模式和只读模式下都不经询问就直接运行。现在 python、python3 只有 --version 和 -V 这两种精确写法算只读，其余都需要批准。从不可信文件夹打开的仓库，不能再借此不经提示地运行它自带的脚本。详见 GHSA-qrrg-f72x-hx7r。 (#14928 by @esengine)

studio-v2.57.0Reasonix Studio v2.57.0 Stable2026-11-02T01:05:21Z

本版新增工作台里的 Word 和 Excel 只读预览；修复 serve 密码出现在进程命令行里的问题，并改进长时间等待后台任务时模型的表现和功耗。

新增

  • 工作台可只读预览 Word（.docx）和 Excel（.xlsx），含多工作表、数字格式和合并单元格；在隔离框中显示、不运行宏和脚本，可在设置里关闭。关联 #14622。

修复

  • 安全：reasonix serve 新增 --password-file，密码从仅所有者可读的文件读取，不再出现在进程命令行里；--hash-password 同样支持。修复 #14913 fixed in #14914。
  • 让模型盯后台长任务（如打包）时，它不再轮询几次就写「未完成」收尾；工具结果会告诉它任务结束后会自动开一轮继续。修复 #14879 fixed in #14900。
  • 视觉效果设为「节能」后，运行中的循环动画（状态标志描线、会话行流光、工具旋转图标）也会停下，长时间等待任务时不再让显卡持续工作。修复 #14919 fixed in #14922。
  • 运行中发送带技能卡片的消息时，按钮和提示如实显示「排队发送」，不再写着「插话」却悄悄排队。关联 #14889。
  • 重启后出现在待发送区、需要你决定的后台任务完成通知，标签写明「后台 · 状态不明」或「后台 · 受阻」，不再和你自己发的消息混在一起。关联 #14885。
  • 文件大小在进位时显示为下一单位（如 1024 KB 显示为 1.0 MB）。关联 #14890 by @kevin9327。
  • 浏览器脚本结果、电脑操控拒绝原因、插件启动失败摘要等处截断的中文不再出现半个字符。关联 #14891 by @kevin9327、#14894 by @kevin9327、#14907 by @kevin9327、#14908 by @kevin9327、#14911 by @kevin9327、#14912 by @kevin9327。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@kevin9327

<!-- lang:en -->

New

  • The workbench previews Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) read-only in an isolated frame with no macros or scripts; it can be turned off in Settings. Refs #14622.

Fixed

  • Security: reasonix serve takes --password-file, reading the password from an owner-only file instead of argv where ps shows it; --hash-password accepts it too. Fixes #14913 fixed in #14914.
  • A model watching a long background job such as a build no longer gives up and reports it unfinished; it is told a new turn starts when the job ends. Fixes #14879 fixed in #14900.
  • Reduced visual effects now also stop the looping run animations (status mark, session-row sweep, tool spinner), so a long wait no longer keeps the GPU busy. Fixes #14919 fixed in #14922.
  • While a turn runs, a message with a skill card shows "Queue" on the button and hint instead of "Steer", since steering carries plain text only. Refs #14889.
  • A background job's follow-on that needs a decision in the pending panel is labelled "Background · uncertain" or "Background · blocked", apart from your own lines. Refs #14885.
  • Byte sizes move to the next unit when rounding carries over: 1024 KB shows as 1.0 MB. Refs #14890 by @kevin9327.
  • Multi-byte text cut in browser results, computer refusals and plugin failure summaries no longer ends in half a character. Refs #14891 by @kevin9327, #14894 by @kevin9327, #14907 by @kevin9327, #14908 by @kevin9327, #14911 by @kevin9327, #14912 by @kevin9327.

Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @kevin9327

What's Changed

  • fix(size): move byte sizes to the next unit when rounding reaches 1024 by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14890
  • fix(capability): cut semantic-router candidate descriptions on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14891
  • fix(composer): name a running send with a skill card as queued by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14893
  • fix(plugin): cut MCP startup failure summaries on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14894
  • fix(queue): label a background job's follow-on that needs a decision as background by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14898
  • fix(jobs): tell the model a running background job resumes the session when it ends by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14900
  • chore(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 4.9.1 to 6.1.0 in the actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14905
  • chore(deps): bump the go group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14901
  • chore(deps): bump the npm group in /desktop/frontend-next with 10 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14906
  • fix(recovery): cut ArgsSummary on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14908
  • fix(evidence): cut quoted mutation-scan segments on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14907
  • test(serve): age seeded sessions through their branch meta by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14909
  • fix(browser): cut a long eval result on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14911
  • fix(computer): cut a long CUA refusal reason on a rune boundary by @kevin9327 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14912
  • fix(serve): read the password from --password-file instead of argv by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14914
  • feat(workbench): preview Word and Excel files read-only by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14915
  • test(boot): show where an extra root moved the cache-stable prefix by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14920
  • fix(studio): Reduced effects also stop the looping run animations by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14922
  • release(studio): notes for 2.57.0 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14923

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.56.1...studio-v2.57.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 .AppImage（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 --appimage-extract-and-run 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

Experimental binaries, not a stable release. Windows preview binaries are unsigned. Use the stable channel for production. Preview numbers may have gaps.

First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support --channel. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against SHA256SUMS, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable jcode on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted .exe.

From that preview binary, run jcode update --channel preview (substitute its full path for jcode) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with update --channel stable, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the v1.0.0 stable tag is created.

First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support --channel. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against SHA256SUMS, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable jcode on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted .exe.

From that preview binary, run jcode update --channel preview (substitute its full path for jcode) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with update --channel stable, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the v1.0.0 stable tag is created.

volcengine/OpenViking ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v0.5.3 Stable2026-11-02T06:33:38Z

OpenViking v0.5.3

中文

OpenViking v0.5.3 在 v0.5.2.1 之上合入 98 个提交，重点是 Rules（Beta）、存储与路径锁可靠性、鉴权与账户管理、Gateway 多副本、Compile 加固和 Agent 插件改进。本版本包含少量管理接口与旧 Session 兼容的破坏性变更，升级前请阅读下方说明。配套发布 python-sdk@0.1.18。

重点更新

  • Rules（Beta）：新增 Rule 服务，并向 Agent 暴露 openviking_rule_search 工具，附中英文指南与 API 参考（#6364、#6613）。
  • 存储与路径锁：新增事务型 SQLite path lock、按 scope 批量刷新 Redis 租约、拒绝跨 scope 的 Tree 锁与路径别名绕过、令牌丢失后撤销租约授权、Provider 迁移后恢复持久化交接；修复递归删除导致 PathLock 提前失效、中文路径旧锁交接恢复；新增可选 Redis 目录 TTL、多写 IOPS 优化（#6679、#6665、#6685、#6687、#6704、#6745、#6631、#6620、#6392、#6646）。
  • 鉴权与账户：支持用户自助轮换 API Key；管理员列表只显示调用者自己的 user key；校验身份角色；支持角色降级与大小写不敏感输入；Group 成员改为批量添加（#6649、#6610、#6752、#6714、#6796）。
  • Gateway：独立 Gateway 可基于 Redis 多副本运行；Session 过期按秒配置；Responses 中 tools: null 正常透传；内嵌 Gateway 数据存放在 storage.workspace 下（#6513、#6651、#6309、#6800）。
  • Compile / 检索：加固目标版本与定时更新、拒绝 system 命名空间作为输入/输出、支持图片源；context 模式可选 rerank 并解耦 rerank.threshold；在线检索绕过入库并发限制；新增 L2 chunk size 配置（#6615、#6634、#6794、#6719、#6605、#6730、#6660）。
  • Agent 插件与连接器：新增 CodeBuddy Code CLI 适配、DeepSeek Harness Desktop、钉钉连接器 OAuth、安装后 Agent onboarding 与历史导入脚本；修复 Codex/pi/opencode/Hermes/MAF 等插件的捕获、提交与去重问题（#5860、#6626、#6609、#6003、#6597、#6598、#6032、#6020、#6799、#6230）。
  • Studio / CLI：改进 Compile 首次使用流程、终端文件系统操作命令、会话面板与指标自适应；CLI 新增 OVPack 进度反馈，add-resource --wait 轮询任务状态（#6491、#6729、#6675、#6487）。

破坏性变更与升级说明

  • 旧 Session 路径兼容移除（#6642）：日常读写只访问 viking://user/{user_id}/sessions/...；旧 viking://session/... URI 返回 INVALID_URI，仅存在于旧目录的 Session 视为不存在。
  • 旧会话迁移退役（#6746）：POST /api/v1/admin/migrate 现在返回 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT；ov admin migrate 及 Python/TypeScript/Go SDK 对应方法已移除。仍有 0.3.x 遗留会话的部署请在旧版本完成迁移后再升级。
  • Group 成员批量接口（#6796）：PUT /api/v1/admin/accounts/{account_id}/groups/{group_id}/members 接收 {"user_ids": [...]}（1–1000 个）；旧的 PUT /members/{user_id} 已移除，单个用户请传单元素数组。
  • 身份校验收紧（#6752）：未知角色和缺失的注册身份会被拒绝。

兼容性与验证

  • 发布目标：178a8cdfb41b51e7d24c4bf79a13cc54981e0ee8。
  • 配套 SDK：openviking-sdk 0.1.18（python-sdk@0.1.18）。
  • 完整变更范围：v0.5.2.1...v0.5.3。v0.5.2.1 分支上的热修复均已包含在本版本中。

首次贡献者

感谢以下首次贡献者：@caozeal、@zhanglistar、@Huxc2020、@wang2-lat、@vriebge、@DURUII、@lvheyang。

English

OpenViking v0.5.3 adds 98 commits on top of v0.5.2.1. The main areas are Rules (Beta), storage and path-lock reliability, auth and account management, multi-replica Gateway, Compile hardening, and agent plugin improvements. A few admin APIs and legacy Session paths change incompatibly; review the notes below before upgrading. Ships alongside python-sdk@0.1.18.

Highlights

  • Rules (Beta): new Rule service and an openviking_rule_search tool for agents, with English and Chinese guides and API reference (#6364, #6613).
  • Storage and path locks: transactional SQLite path locks, batched Redis lease refresh per scope, rejection of cross-scope Tree locks and path-alias bypasses, lease revocation after token loss, and durable handoff recovery after provider migration. Fixes early PathLock expiry during recursive delete and legacy lock handoff for Chinese paths. Also adds an opt-in Redis directory TTL and multi-write IOPS optimizations (#6679, #6665, #6685, #6687, #6704, #6745, #6631, #6620, #6392, #6646).
  • Auth and accounts: self-service user API key rotation, admin listings that reveal only the caller's own user key, identity role validation, role demotion with case-insensitive input, and batch group-member additions (#6649, #6610, #6752, #6714, #6796).
  • Gateway: the standalone gateway can run as a multi-replica service on Redis. Session expiry is configured in seconds, a null tools field in Responses replies is relayed instead of failing, and embedded gateway data lives under storage.workspace (#6513, #6651, #6309, #6800).
  • Compile / retrieval: hardened target versioning and scheduled updates, rejection of system namespace inputs and outputs, and image sources. Rerank for context mode is now opt-in with a decoupled rerank.threshold, online retrieval bypasses ingestion concurrency limits, and the L2 chunk size is configurable (#6615, #6634, #6794, #6719, #6605, #6730, #6660).
  • Agent plugins and connectors: CodeBuddy Code CLI adapter, DeepSeek Harness Desktop, DingTalk connector OAuth, and post-install agent onboarding with a history import script. Fixes capture, commit, and dedup issues in the Codex, pi, opencode, Hermes, and MAF plugins (#5860, #6626, #6609, #6003, #6597, #6598, #6032, #6020, #6799, #6230).
  • Studio / CLI: a better first-use Compile workflow, filesystem mutation commands in the terminal, and responsive session panes and metrics. The CLI shows OVPack progress, and add-resource --wait polls task status (#6491, #6729, #6675, #6487).

Breaking changes and migration

  • Legacy Session path compatibility removed (#6642): sessions are only read and written under viking://user/{user_id}/sessions/.... Legacy viking://session/... URIs return INVALID_URI, and sessions that exist only in legacy directories are treated as missing.
  • Legacy session migration retired (#6746): POST /api/v1/admin/migrate now returns 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT. ov admin migrate and the matching Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK methods are removed. Deployments that still hold 0.3.x sessions should migrate them on an older release before upgrading.
  • Batch group-member API (#6796): PUT /api/v1/admin/accounts/{account_id}/groups/{group_id}/members takes {"user_ids": [...]} (1–1000). The old PUT /members/{user_id} route is removed; for a single user, send a one-element array.
  • Stricter identity validation (#6752): unknown roles and missing registered identities are rejected.

Compatibility and verification

  • Release target: 178a8cdfb41b51e7d24c4bf79a13cc54981e0ee8.
  • Companion SDK: openviking-sdk 0.1.18 (python-sdk@0.1.18).
  • Full change range: v0.5.2.1...v0.5.3. All hotfixes from the v0.5.2.1 branch are included.

New contributors

Thanks to first-time contributors @caozeal, @zhanglistar, @Huxc2020, @wang2-lat, @vriebge, @DURUII, and @lvheyang.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.5.2.1...v0.5.3

thedotmack/claude-mem ↗ 3 releases · 3 stable
v15.8.3 Stable2026-11-02T06:26:25Z

Privacy fix

Browser setup no longer uploads your prompts to cmem.ai without asking. Fixes #5176.

The browser setup opened by npx claude-mem install (since v15.2.0) scanned local agent histories and uploaded the full text of the last 30 days of prompts, with session IDs, project names, folder paths and timestamps, without asking.

What changed (#5220)

  • The scan now reads local history only, then stops and asks. Nothing leaves the machine until you answer.
  • A new consent panel states what is sent and lists each detected tool with its prompt count. Only ticked tools are uploaded.
  • "Keep everything local", or unticking every tool, uploads nothing.
  • The analytics box is optional, off by default, and separate from upload consent.
  • A second start request while the question is open, or during an upload, joins the current state instead of starting a second upload.
  • New POST /api/setup/scan/consent route: loopback-only and origin-guarded.

Not covered by this release

  • Prompts already uploaded by earlier versions are not removed by this update.
  • Server-side handling at cmem.ai and privacy-policy wording are outside this change.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.8.2...v15.8.3

Fixes

  • Work view: telemetry volume cuts. High-volume events (observer turns, work-state use, context injections, searches, skills) are now one daily rollup per install with a count; worker start/stop carry restart_count; failures are one event per type per day with count.
  • Observer: after a spent cmem.ai allowance, the gateway is probed once a day instead of on every resume.
  • Work view: fixed a runaway "opened" event; hosted viewer reports analytics with viewer_host='hosted'.
  • Work view: idle task cards no longer show a spinner (#5266).

Includes #5266, #5269.

oh-my-codex v0.21.46

Summary

This patch release keeps generated native-agent instructions within the assigned scope and clarifies Git Master's task authority for history and remote writes.

Fixed

  • ASSIGNMENT-SCOPED NATIVE AGENT OVERLAYS (#3989): Generated posture and exact-model guidance no longer tell read-only or advisory roles to implement or always build. Specialist coverage, completion criteria, and verification requirements follow the assignment and repository/task requirements.
  • GIT MASTER AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES (#3997): History rewrites and remote writes require task authority. Preserve unrelated dirty and untracked work without stashing, resetting, cleaning, or overwriting it; split independent concerns while keeping a behavior's required tests and support files together.

Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata was already synchronized to 0.21.46 on dev by #3993; the release branch does not bump those surfaces again.

Verification

  • npm ci — passed.

v0.21.45 Stable2026-11-01T19:15:23Z

oh-my-codex v0.21.45

Summary

This patch release fixes omx doctor falsely reporting an unsafe trust migration for an unchanged foreign Codex hook group whose matcher is the empty string (#3984).

Fixed

  • EMPTY FOREIGN HOOK MATCHER TRUST (#3985, fixes #3984): Preserve any string matcher, including "", in the foreign hook trust hash input. Previously the truthiness check omitted an empty matcher, causing the calculated hash to differ from Codex's stored trust hash and omx doctor to report unsafe_managed_removal for an unchanged trusted hook group.

The fix targets the empty-matcher hash mismatch. The separately reported SessionEnd outlier is not addressed.

Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata was already synchronized to 0.21.45 on dev by #3982; the release does not bump those surfaces again.

Verification

  • npm test — passed, including runtime build/tests, all 475 Node test files, generated catalog checks, and prompt-invariant checks.

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

stablyai/orca ↗ 2 releases · 1 stable · 1 prerelease
v1.4.246 Stable2026-11-02T03:19:48Z

Orchestrator V3, improved terminal, Chat UI out of experimental & a refreshed phone app ✨

  • 🤝 Orchestrator V3: A lot more token efficient and reliable. Works with both CLI agents and Chat UI, with visual worker indicators in Chat UI to help you follow progress.
  • 🔕 Quieter notifications: Orca now filters out worker agent notifications during orchestration.
  • 📱 A refreshed Orca Mobile: Choose Light, Dark or System and pick your display language in Settings. Enjoy cleaner screens, smoother sheets and faster workspace lists.
  • 💬 Chat UI is out of experimental: Choose Chat or CLI for each agent, queue follow-ups while it works, and continue with another account or agent harness when you hit a usage limit.
  • ⌨️ Improved terminals: Faster input for terminal agents, more reliable session restores, and fixes for text rendering, links and padding.
  • 🎨 Make Orca yours: Choose an editor theme independently of the app, add a background image, or match the whole window to your terminal theme.
  • 🧩 Explore community plugins: Browse the community catalog, try syntax themes, and build your own panels with TypeScript and TSX.
  • 🖱️ Improved computer use & browser use: More reliable background browsing, sign-in popups, uploads and downloads, plus computer-use fixes on Windows and Linux.

Highlights

  • Mobile theme & language pickers: Pick Light, Dark or System for the phone app and choose your display language in Settings → Appearance and Language.
  • A refreshed phone app: A Home screen focused on what needs you, compact top bars, bottom search, filter chips, clearer lists and smoother sheets. Workspace lists load with less data, images and Mermaid diagrams support pinch-to-zoom, and iOS can show inline HTML cards and previews. Run automations from your phone too.
  • Plugins: The community catalog is visible by default, with public install counts and clearer publisher information. Plugin authors get TypeScript and TSX without a separate build step, component-based panels, worker communication, hot reload and CLI tools for testing and screenshots.
  • Chat UI: Chat leaves Experimental. Choose Chat or CLI in each agent’s Settings row, with default model and effort choices. Follow-up messages queue by default while an agent works; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends one straight into the running turn. Switch accounts for open chats, or continue a usage-limited conversation with another account or agent harness.
  • Themes & editors: Set a separate code editor theme, tune editor typography, use background images, and apply Match Terminal across the whole window. Preview SVG source alongside the image, click to zoom images and Alt-drag to pan.
  • Source Control: Resolve conflicts and complete merges on desktop or phone. Open every changed file from the mobile diff screen, return a pull request to draft from a paired phone, and refresh checks and reviews with current provider data.
  • Browser & computer use: Agents can work with sign-in and payment popups, upload through file-picker buttons in nested frames, answer page dialogs and save downloads to the requested path. Background browser pages stay active while agents use them.
  • Orchestrator V3: A lot more token efficient and reliable. Coordinators end their turn and wake when workers report back, with shorter CLI status and inbox output. It works great in Chat UI, where visual worker cards and activity indicators help you follow progress. Give finished workers follow-up tasks and reopen closed workers.
  • Everyday speed & polish: Less whole-app hitching with many chats, quicker shell submissions, faster worktree checkout, and fewer redraws in chats and diffs. Child agents start collapsed, with idle agents grouped together on desktop and phone.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

  • Chat or CLI per agent: Chat UI no longer needs the Experimental switch. Existing users keep their launch preferences and existing conversations keep their surface. New installs start in Terminal. Choose Chat or CLI and the default model and effort in Settings → Agents.
  • Follow-ups queue by default: While an agent works, Enter queues your next message. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends it into the running turn instead. Turn off Queue follow-ups in Settings → Chat → Behavior to change the default. On a phone, hold Send to choose Queue or Steer. The phone follows its host’s setting; older clients or hosts without queue support keep sending immediately.
  • Mobile app updates: Native Settings changes, including the theme and language pickers, require an updated mobile app. Update Orca Mobile as well as your desktop or server to get the full experience.
  • Plugin trust & updates: Orca warns before trusting non-official plugins. Updates that request more access wait for individual review, and installed plugin content is verified again when loaded.
  • Isolated desktop plugin views: Plugin panels and custom editors now use separate processes and storage with direct network access blocked. Browser and serve clients retain their existing iframe behavior.
  • WSL hosts: Stopped distros stay stopped when restoring or switching workspaces, and blocked panes offer Start. Turning the WSL hosts setting off stops new hosts and moves while saved hosts keep serving. Idle WSL servers can exit after five minutes without putting that idle timeout in your own shells.
  • Orca skills: Unedited bundled skills update automatically. Skills you have changed still prompt for review.

Product experience

Terminals

Quicker prompt submission, more reliable restores and fixes for text weight, links, padding and Windows startup errors.

  • Bound the in-process macOS process table's blocking calls and ps fallbacks (#31783) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/36282
  • Fix macOS daemon PTY kqueue descriptor leak by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16870

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v3.24.1v3.24.1 — Plugin installs from a claude.ai account marketplace, reviewer card confirmation, and a Brazilian Portuguese README Stable2026-11-02T03:06:04Z

Install repairs for claude.ai and Claude Desktop; no new skill or mode: ARS now installs from a claude.ai account marketplace. Before this release, that install loaded none of the five core skills (#1035), and claude.ai left out the four plugin agents because their names had underscores (#1037). On Claude Desktop, a skill and /ars-lit-review ran in plain chat, a project session dispatched the synthesis-agent plugin agent, and the SessionStart announce appeared in folder work. The write-scope guard, the tools allowlist, and a full pipeline run are untested on claude.ai and Claude Desktop. The reviewer now waits for the user to confirm the Reviewer Configuration Cards (#1030), and the README has a Brazilian Portuguese translation (#1032).

Added

  • A Brazilian Portuguese README, README.pt-BR.md (#1032, translated by @laqueiroz; PR #1033). It is translated from the v3.24.0 README.md and keeps code blocks, example prompts, file paths, mode names, and schema and field names in English. The six other READMEs link to it from their language bars. check_readme_pt_sections() in scripts/check_spec_consistency.py pins its version badge, mode and skill headings, DOCX line, and three-release changelog section, and scripts/check_reviewer_role_label.py pins its Journal-Fit Reviewer wording. pt-BR was added after the 2026-09-15 README slimming, so it has no frozen docs/changelog-archive/ copy. No skill, agent, trigger keyword, or locale pack changes.

Changed

  • The reviewer waits for the user to confirm the Reviewer Configuration Cards before Phase 1 (#1030). Checkpoint Rule 1 in academic-paper-reviewer/SKILL.md said to present the cards and let the user adjust them, but not to wait, so a run could show the cards and start the panel in the same turn. It is now an Iron Rule: after Phase 0 the session shows every card and ends its turn, and no reviewer seat is dispatched until the user, in their own turn, accepts the whole set, with or without edits; a reply that only edits some cards gets the updated cards shown again. It applies to full, methodology-focus, guided, and quick, including a Stage 3 review in academic-pipeline, whose orchestrator now names the stop in its checkpoint rules; calibration does not pause, and re-review runs no Phase 0. Only the user's own request to skip the card confirmation skips it, not a general request to skip questions, [direct-mode], or text in the manuscript. In a full review, the confirmed cards are the Round-1 cards that re-review reuses. scripts/check_reviewer_card_confirmation.py pins the wording, and scripts/test_check_reviewer_card_confirmation.py holds its mutation tests. The rule is prompt-level; whether sessions stop at it is unmeasured.

Fixed

  • A plugin installed from a claude.ai account marketplace loads the five core skills (#1035, reported by @thepogodude; PR #1036). The account-marketplace sync drops symlinks, so the skills/ symlink directory disappeared and no core skill registered. .claude-plugin/plugin.json now declares the five skill paths, and the skills/ directory is gone; keeping both would load every skill twice in Claude Code. .claude-plugin/marketplace.json keeps its skills array for the Claude Science importer (#480). scripts/check_skill_inventory_parity.py compares plugin.json skills[] instead of the symlinks, fails if a skills path exists, and reports a duplicate entry in either manifest. Checked on the synced copy in Claude Code (21 skills, no double loading next to a GitHub-marketplace install) and on the claude.ai plugin page (five skills).
  • The four plugin agents have hyphenated names, which claude.ai accepts (#1037, PR #1038). claude.ai rejects an agent name with an underscore, so the account marketplace synced the plugin without its agents and showed a warning for each. The frontmatter names are now synthesis-agent, research-architect-agent, report-compiler-agent, and screening-reviewer-agent; file names and the role IDs in schemas, contracts, and passports do not change. The write-scope guard manifest uses the new names, and LEGACY_AGENT_NAMES in scripts/ars_write_scope_guard.py maps an old underscore name, bare or plugin-scoped, to the new one, so an old agent copy stays fenced. In sr-screener, a saved screening_config.json with the old plugin-scoped reviewer name dispatches to the new name and keeps its stage identity, so a screening in progress keeps its decisions; a bare old name, which is a skills-copy agent the user installed, dispatches unchanged. The methods-text access sentence now appears under either reviewer name. After the merge, the marketplace warnings were gone, and a Claude Desktop project session listed the four agents and dispatched academic-research-skills:synthesis-agent directly. A pre-existing overstatement in that methods sentence is tracked in #1039.

Docs

  • SETUP documents the claude.ai and Claude Desktop install (PR #1041). Method 0 (en/zh-TW) gains an account-marketplace subsection: the install steps, what runs in plain chat and in project or folder work (Anthropic's documented scope, kept apart from our checks on Claude Desktop before and after #1037), what was not tested, the Claude Code sync and its API-key and cloud-provider exclusion, and a warning against keeping uploaded or copied skills next to the plugin. The account marketplace is the recommended claude.ai route; Method 3 (skill upload) is the fallback for a plan without plugins or an organization marketplace list that leaves this repository out. Method 4b is retitled "repository reading" and notes that Anthropic lists "Add from GitHub" as not yet supported once chat and Cowork merge. docs/CONTROL_AVAILABILITY.md adds a claude.ai plugin channel with plain-chat and Desktop project/folder columns, an Untested legend value, and note 11. The README (en/zh-TW) quick start names the claude.ai route. A possibly outdated Method 3 claim about uploaded skills is tracked in #1040.

"It's okay to be lost. Even lost, keep going." — 《BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!》 (2023)

✨ What's New

Feature Description
Release notes shortcuts Shortcuts follow your system's notation (like Alt+V on Windows), and settings show up as inline switches you can flip right from the notes.

🐛 Bug Fixes

Fix Description
Gemini quote reply Turned off by default now that Gemini has its own, and turned off once on every device that still had it on.
Folder rename The rename field in the sidebar no longer collapses when renaming a folder on DeepSeek, ChatGPT or Claude.
Safari cloud sync Switching accounts mid-sync keeps Undo, and a deleted backup folder is found again, so Restore previous version is no longer empty.

All changes by @Nagi-ovo unless noted.

中文版

「迷路也没关系，迷路了也要前进。」——《BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!》（2023）

✨ 新功能

功能 说明
更新说明里的快捷键 快捷键按你的系统显示（比如 Windows 上是 Alt+V），设置项直接以可切换的开关呈现。

🐛 修复

修复 说明
Gemini 引用回复 Gemini 已自带引用回复，这次默认关闭 Voyager 的版本，并在仍开启的设备上关闭一次。
文件夹重命名 在 DeepSeek、ChatGPT、Claude 上重命名文件夹时，侧边栏的输入框不再被挤窄。
Safari 云同步 同步中途换账号不再丢掉「撤销」；备份文件夹被删后能重新找到，「恢复上一版」不再是空的。

除特别注明外，均由 @Nagi-ovo 提交。

<details> <summary><b>🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade)</b></summary>

🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari.

  • 📦 安装 (Installation): 下载并打开 voyager-v2.3.1.dmg，按提示安装应用。 Download and open voyager-v2.3.1.dmg, then follow the prompts to install the app.
  • ⚠️ 旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade): 如果仍安装着 Gemini Voyager.app，请先完成一次 Safari 迁移步骤，避免两个 App 并存。 If Gemini Voyager.app is still installed, follow the one-time Safari migration guide first so the two apps do not conflict.
  • 🖼️ 图片能力 (Images): Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported.
  • ☁️ 原生云同步 (Native cloud sync): Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer.
  • 🔔 系统通知 (Notifications): Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation.
  • 🔄 自动更新 (Automatic updates): 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

</details>

Tencent/BrowserSkill ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
ext-v0.4.1BrowserSkill Extension 0.4.1 Stable2026-11-01T16:50:10Z

BrowserSkill 0.4.1 coordinates the CLI/daemon, browser extension and DSH plugin.

Changed

  • Shared-control default: new CLI and DSH sync calls select target policy. DOM actions can reuse the returned control context across completed actions and supplementary reads; unrelated page updates no longer require a full-page resync. Human intervention or navigation revokes control. Use --expect / DSH expect to protect observed business facts. Scripts, untargeted keys and visual actions still require the sync's --observation / observationId and strict observation checks. Select --policy strict / policy: "strict" on the first sync to retain the one-action-per-context workflow; later syncs and steps preserve that session's policy.
  • CLI/daemon and extension now use protocol 1.8. The new target policy requires both peers to support 1.8; update the CLI, running daemon, extension and DSH plugin together rather than relying on a successful mixed-version connection.
  • DOM references remain attached to the same nodes across supplementary observations. Removed nodes are not silently replaced, and navigation invalidates the document's refs. DOM actions can wait for an existing target to become ready within their timeout without replaying input.

Fixed

  • Interaction capture initializes on ordinary HTTP intranet pages and their child frames when crypto.randomUUID() is unavailable. A compatible UUID fallback restores the frame coverage needed for shared control.
  • Shared-control synchronization waits for cancelled observation thumbnails to settle. Viewport capture reads have a 10-second deadline with separate bounded cleanup; reaching that deadline returns timeout (exit 4) with screenshot-specific guidance. Browser/CDP capture failures remain cdp_failed (exit 3).
  • Completed inputs retain their successful receipts when they navigate, including clicks, Enter submissions, drag submissions, and forms submitted after filling or selecting a value. After navigation, synchronize before the next action.
  • CLI cancellation is armed before sending a browser command, so an immediate Ctrl-C can cancel the operation and return its outcome instead of terminating silently.
  • Pointer hit tests stay within the target's document, and human input during frame changes continues to revoke control without discarding completed actions.
  • Windows daemon startup errors distinguish verified Job Object restrictions, unverified breakaway failures, executable access failures, partial breakaway and resume failures, with recovery guidance for the actual failure stage.
  • DSH-injected messages use native durable-format v4 plugin sources while retaining the legacy source shape for older formats.

Removed

  • Automatic native Agent Window tab groups and the tabGroups permission, to prevent new BrowserSkill groups from accumulating across browsers through Chrome sync. Existing saved groups are not deleted; page control indicators, background window behavior and user-tab routing remain available.

Upgrade

  1. Finish active tasks, install CLI 0.4.1 and restart the running daemon.
  2. Install extension 0.4.1 before upgrading the DSH plugin to 0.4.1. Store review can delay availability; verify the installed extension, not just its submission.
  3. Restart the DSH profile and invoke /browser-skill again, or start a new CLI agent conversation to load the updated skill. Custom tool integrations need the new observation and expectation fields for target-policy actions.
  4. Check bsk --version, bsk status and bsk doctor; the running daemon and extension should both report protocol 1.8.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/blob/b8f2d4f0fa35c8c7c866229e1cf3b3329ae39de5/CHANGELOG.md

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.24CC Switch v4.0.24 Stable2026-11-01T15:05:37Z

CC Switch v4.0.24

本版本在授权中心加了「登录时自动打开浏览器」开关，关掉后登录账号只复制登录链接，由你自己选浏览器打开，适合每个账号用独立浏览器环境的用户。另外修复了 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由用 GPT 6.1 Sol / Terra 时 max 思考档位被降成 xhigh、DeepSeek Harness 选了支持 PDF 输入的模型后第三方供应商全部不显示、WSL 上 CC Switch 启动就退出、Codex 的 Chat 供应商重开「支持思考等级」后思考档位发不出去等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

登录账号时可以只复制链接

以前在授权中心登录账号，一律用系统默认浏览器打开登录页。用 AdsPower 这类工具给每个账号单独开浏览器环境的话，登录会落到错误的浏览器里。

现在授权中心顶部多了「登录时自动打开浏览器」开关，Claude、ChatGPT、Copilot、xAI、Antigravity、Kimi、DeepSeek 账号登录都受它控制，包括在添加供应商表单里发起的登录。关掉后：

  • 点登录只把登录链接复制到剪贴板，在你要用的浏览器里打开、登录并同意授权，CC Switch 会自动更新。
  • 需要输入验证码的登录不再自动复制验证码，免得把剪贴板里的链接顶掉。
  • 等待登录时可以点「复制登录链接」再复制一次，打开登录页的按钮不显示。

Windows 上 Claude Code 会自己打开浏览器，开关关掉时 CC Switch 会让它只输出登录链接。

开关默认打开，只记在这台电脑上，不随云同步。

预设： A6API 改用新域名 a6api.vip。

修复

  • Claude Code、Claude Desktop 经路由连 OpenAI 格式的上游、模型是 gpt-6.1-sol 或 gpt-6.1-terra 时，max 思考档位被降成 xhigh 发出（#9122）。现在 GPT 5.6 及以后的版本，不带后缀或带 sol、terra、luna、astra 后缀的模型都保留 max；pro、codex、mini 等其他后缀仍按 xhigh 发。
  • DeepSeek Harness 从拉取到的模型列表里选了支持 PDF 输入的模型后，第三方供应商全部不显示（#9116）。DeepSeek Harness 的模型输入类型只认文字和图片，写进去一个 PDF 就会让这一条配置整体失效。现在只写文字和图片。
  • WSL 上 CC Switch 启动后直接退出，报托盘图标「Permission denied」（#9021、#9020）。Linux 的托盘图标改为放在应用的缓存目录。
  • Codex 的 Chat 供应商关掉再打开「支持思考等级」后，选的思考档位不再发给上游（#8998、#8954）。GitHub Copilot 等上游因此收不到任何思考档位。以前保存过的供应商不用重新编辑，也会恢复正常。
  • DeepSeek Harness 的「DeepSeek 官方登录」卡片写着「用 Claude 账号登录」（#9058）。现在是「用 DeepSeek 账号登录」。

致谢

感谢 @gddg（WSL 托盘）、@guishiw（Codex 思考等级）、@iSanae233（DeepSeek 登录文案）的贡献。

感谢 @Xinyu-Li-1997、@clickwzy、@mhsbz、@ggbdpq 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。
